appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/architecture.md to reflect Droid as implemented (Engine/AgentChoice wording and droid_events parser listing).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify and enforce rust-worker RED-phase expectations (when strict fail-first tests are required vs acceptable exceptions), and require truthful `followedProcedure` reporting when RED phase is skipped.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Three reviewed sessions reported `followedProcedure: true` while transcript skeletons showed implementation edits before any failing-test run.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit scrutiny/pre-handoff checklist item requiring zero `_` catchall arms in Engine/AgentType matches for variant-expansion features, with concrete grep-based verification.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Despite the existing rule, droid-engine-and-model left multiple Engine catchalls (`src/wagner.rs`, `src/transport/telegram/mod.rs`) and still passed worker handoff.
